gate.denominator: all source-resolvable in-scope DATE and EMAIL distinct field-value instances, including unrecovered/failed items
gate.meaning: larger shadow evaluation consideration only; no production certification

ready_handshake: Owner finalizes, validates and returns exact manifest hash
Primary verifies all owner hashes and records Freeze A
Collector begins fresh selection only after Freeze A
Source-only reviewer labels all pages; labels owner READY and stops editing
Primary records Freeze B and starts runtime
Later changes become separate version/deviation; never mutate frozen history
evaluation_scaffold_freeze: May follow implementation Freeze A during collection; must precede source labeling and runtime/model outputs.
